text: I heard about Tom Revell's murder, Curtis. Is that why you've come?
The way that really got to me for some reason.
Wait a minute. How do you know about Tom?
What, is WynTech trying to check up on me or something?
No, not at all, Curtis. Detective Powell came and spoke with me this morning.
Oh. I don't know why, but that makes me feel a little better.
